summary: Chat input lacks character counter (UX pair to /api/query 4000-char cap)
description:
The chat input component currently has no character counter, so users can't see they're approaching the server-side 4000-char cap (b96dcd5b) until they hit submit and get a 400.

Fix: add a small char counter in the chat input. Recommended behavior:
- Hidden / muted color until ~3000 chars (75%).
- Visible muted color 3000-3800.
- Red 3800-4000.
- The send button is the authoritative gate — disable + tooltip when over 4000, but do not auto-truncate.

Files (likely): src/app/(app)/chat/* or wherever the chat input lives.

Pairs with: b96dcd5b (server cap is the authoritative validation; this ticket is purely UX).
